entities.summary: Celorico da Beira is a municipality in Guarda District in Portugal. The municipality population in 2011 was 7,693, in an area of 247.22 km2. Maçal do Chão was a freguesia of Portugal in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
